ABOUT.TITLE: About Me
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION: I'm Victor Alves. A tech enthusiast since childhood, I went from tinkering with computers to writing code. Today, I'm a developer with solid experience in Python, Angular, and .NET, and always eager to learn new technologies. In my free time, I enjoy working out, playing video games, and card games with friends.

PROBLEM-SOLVING.TITLE: Highlights
PROBLEM-SOLVING.SUBTITLE: Some of my most impactful contributions

KML_UPLOAD.TITLE: KML File Processing and Map Integration
KML_UPLOAD.DESCRIPTION: I developed a feature in a legacy system to upload and display KML coordinate files directly on the embedded map. The solution was efficient and reusable, and I later adapted it for a newer system to ensure consistency across platforms.

LEADERSHIP.TITLE: RPA Project Leadership
LEADERSHIP.DESCRIPTION: Led a team of 3 developers to build RPA bots that converted spreadsheet data into multiple proprietary formats recognized by the client’s system.

PIPELINES.TITLE: CI/CD Pipeline Automation
PIPELINES.DESCRIPTION: Automated deployment processes using Azure DevOps, eliminating manual errors and improving delivery consistency.

TEAM_GROWTH.TITLE: Onboarding and Mentoring of New Developers
TEAM_GROWTH.DESCRIPTION: Actively participated in the hiring process and was responsible for onboarding and mentoring new developers joining the team, ensuring smooth integration and best practices from day one.

TEMP_TABLES.TITLE: SQL Optimization with Temporary Tables
TEMP_TABLES.DESCRIPTION: Improved a stored procedure used for client report extraction by implementing temporary tables. The query time was reduced by up to 70%, directly improving the client’s daily operations.

TEAM_SUPPORT.TITLE: Cross-team Collaboration
TEAM_SUPPORT.DESCRIPTION: Provided support to another team to help deliver a system on time. The collaborative effort ensured the project met its deadline and satisfied the client.

RPA_RESILIENCE.TITLE: Increased RPA Stability
RPA_RESILIENCE.DESCRIPTION: Resolved an intermittent issue in an RPA that retrieved medical reports from an iframe. Instead of relying on the DOM, I used authorized credentials to access the PDF directly via a server request, ensuring reliable data extraction.

CUSTOM_FEEDBACK.TITLE: Custom Visual Rating System
CUSTOM_FEEDBACK.DESCRIPTION: As an intern, I was tasked with creating a unique post-consultation rating component using the company logo instead of stars. I implemented this using SCSS conditionals to swap between grayscale and colored logos on hover, enhancing the visual experience for patients.
